name: Four Seasons Hotel Shanghai at Puxi
insider_take: This ultra-luxe tower rises 37 floors above Shanghai's historic Puxi district, where East meets West in the most sophisticated way possible.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 3-37 of the prestigious Puxi Financial Tower, offering breathtaking views of the Huangpu River and iconic Pudong skyline. Its location on Nanjing Road West places you steps from luxury shopping and just minutes from the famous Bund waterfront promenade.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on the higher floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the Oriental Pearl Tower and Shanghai Tower – the golden hour lighting is absolutely magical for photos.
dont_miss: The hotel's Camelia restaurant serves exceptional Cantonese cuisine, while the 37th-floor spa offers treatments with panoramic city views. Take evening strolls along the nearby Bund to see the dazzling light show across the Huangpu River.
pros: Prime location in Puxi district with excellent access to business centers and attractions
Exceptional Four Seasons service standards with personalized attention
Luxurious accommodations with modern amenities and elegant design
Outstanding dining options featuring international and local cuisine
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Located in busy urban environment with city noise levels
